scripts.build: npm run codegen && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run schema:validate && npm run test -w @owlpane/codegen && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:go && npm run test:python && npm run test:ruby
scripts.test:go: cd packages/go && go test ./... && bash scripts/conformance.sh
scripts.test:python: cd packages/python && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -e '.[dev]' && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && bash scripts/conformance.sh
